StorySculpt saves that objective on the script itself and shows it at the top of your finished script so you can check the draft against the audience and next step you intended. name.value: What does finishing a script mean?

value.value: What does finishing a script mean?

name.value: Finishing closes the interview to new turns and assembles your answers into a script you can record. Once a script is finished, the interview is locked so your script stays stable. A new answer cannot be added to a finished interview; use Refine with a note to change the script, or start a new chat for your next script. Copy it or download the text file when you are ready to film. Your saved script does not expire; it stays in your account until you delete it.

name.value: If something you type says you are thinking about ending your life, hurting yourself, or hurting someone else, StorySculpt does not write the next step. It pauses and shows free, confidential lines you can reach right now: call or text 988 in the US and Canada, 116 123 (Samaritans) in the UK and Ireland, 13 11 14 (Lifeline) in Australia, or findahelpline.com anywhere else. If you are in immediate danger, call your local emergency number. Nothing you wrote is deleted, and the chat is there when you are ready to come back. StorySculpt is an AI writing tool, not a counselor.
